title: Cash-Leg Window Exposure
description: Computes how long a token leg that settles at any hour waits for a cash leg that only moves while a payment rail is open, against a rail calendar or UTC windows the caller declares: exposure seconds, principal-seconds, next window open and close, weekend crossing and an optional carry cost (actual over 365, half-even). The node hardcodes no calendar and reads no clock.

token_leg_time.description: Instant the token leg settles, strict UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ with a valid calendar date. Offsets, fractions and impossible dates are refused.

as_of.description: Caller-declared evaluation instant, same strict UTC shape. No clock is read; a token leg after as_of is flagged.

principal_minor_units.description: Principal in integer minor units as a positive decimal string of at most 18 digits. Numbers and floats are refused, never coerced.

funding_rate_bp.description: Optional funding rate in whole basis points, 0 to 100000, for the carry cost. Absent means no carry figure; a present null or float is refused.

horizon_days.description: Optional search horizon in whole days, 1 to 60; 14 when absent. A present null is refused.

cash_instrument.description: Optional label echoed on the receipt: fiat_bank_money, stablecoin, deposit_token or future_instrument. Any other value is refused.

cash_leg_open_windows.description: Declared UTC cash windows, 1 to 500 items of open_utc and close_utc (open inclusive, close exclusive). Declare exactly one of this or rail_calendar.

close_utc.description: Window close, strict UTC instant, after open_utc.

rail_calendar.description: Declared versioned rail table: rail_id, calendar_version, source_pin, covers_from and covers_to (YYYY-MM-DD), window_rules (weekdays 0 to 6, open_day_offset -1 or 0, open_local, close_day_offset 0 or 1, close_local), utc_offset_segments (from_date, to_date, offset_minutes) and holidays (business-day dates with no window). Never hardcoded by the node.

calendar_version.description: Caller label for the table version.

source_pin.description: Where the declared hours and holidays came from.

covers_from.description: First date the table covers, YYYY-MM-DD.

covers_to.description: Last date the table covers, YYYY-MM-DD.

utc_offset_segments.description: UTC offsets declared by date range.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads. No required array: every refusal (absent token time, missing or ambiguous calendar, float principal) is a structured refusal payload, so each refusal branch stays reachable through every call path.
